items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: And in fact she played with me over there a long time then she went with Howard.

ctx.x: She could pass across the lake. Yeah.

And in fact she played with me over there a long time then she went with Howard. And she played with Howard at the Palace Theater, you know. And then in between she was playing with Milly Barnes back at the old folks home. She's real bright, huh? No, she's a Bronskin club. She's a Bronskin club. She's a Bronskin club. But she plays with a white band. Yeah, she's got a white band, yeah. I don't know the facts. Somebody told me that she's living one of the boys.
